article.title: 數雲發布Synwin平台，整合消費者資料與行銷代理
article.title_en: Shuyun introduces Synwin to connect consumer data and marketing agents
article.summary: 數雲10月30日介紹Synwin Agent Platform，以資料、模型網關、工具及代理入口串連零售消費者營運。
article.summary_en: Shuyun’s October 30 announcement introduces Synwin Agent Platform, linking consumer data, model routing, tools and an agent interface for retail operations.

article.detail:
數雲10月30日介紹Synwin Agent Platform，以資料、模型網關、工具及代理入口串連零售消費者營運。

平台稱已接入DeepSeek、Kimi、千問、OpenAI、Claude及Gemini。

工具以MCP供代理調用；Insights、Campaign及Clienteling代理將陸續上架。

中國零售品牌可從現有CRM及CDP接入評估，而非只比較生成內容。

先確認可用代理、部署範圍與模型資料流，再選一個低風險會員流程。

公告未列出全部代理即時可用日期；所稱私隱、合規及ROI效果未獨立驗證。
article.detail_en:
Shuyun’s October 30 announcement introduces Synwin Agent Platform, linking consumer data, model routing, tools and an agent interface for retail operations.

The vendor lists DeepSeek, Kimi, Qwen, OpenAI, Claude and Gemini connections.

Tools expose MCP access; Insights, Campaign and Clienteling agents are scheduled to roll out progressively.

China-facing retailers can assess CRM and CDP integration alongside content generation.

Confirm available agents, deployment scope and model data flows, then pilot one low-risk member workflow.

The release provides no universal agent-availability date. Privacy, compliance and ROI claims are not independently validated.

evidence.reviewed_by: Codex editorial desk; same-assistant original reading and separate-request second pass, no independent human reviewer

independent_review.method: Same assistant reopened the original through a separate web request and challenged date, numbers, availability, attribution, causality and language parity. No independent person or subagent, human approval, product trial or measured outcome claimed.
independent_review.finding: Reopened original. Changed all-agents-available implication to progressive Agent Store rollout. Removed 75% statistic, brand counts, ROI maximization and legal-compliance guarantees. Model connections do not establish lawful cross-border deployment.
